description: Atlas evidence: submit an issuer name as the Tokenization Atlas dataset spells it, for example Paxos Trust Company, NA. The signed brief lists that issuer’s assets with their taxonomy stages and the six rights fields per asset (issuer involvement, custody and backing, distributions, voting, legal status, redemption), counting disclosed against not disclosed per field and in total. An unknown name returns issuer_not_found with the dataset issuer names that contain it. POST /api/atlas-issuer-brief. Reads the published Tokenization Atlas dataset at https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets once per call, with no dataset writes and no issuer contact. Every report names the dataset version it read, and a field or history the dataset does not hold is reported as not in the published dataset. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/atlas-evidence-contract. Human page: https://atlas.weverlabs.com/.

issuer.description: The issuer name exactly as the dataset spells it, matched case-insensitively with spacing normalized. Example: Paxos Trust Company, NA.
